title: Design, synthesis, and molecular dynamic simulations of some novel benzo[d]thiazoles with anti-virulence activity against Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
authors: Mohammed, Esraa Z; El-Dydamony, Nehad M; Taha, Enas A; Taha, Mostafa N; Mehany, Ahmed B M; Abdel Aziz, Hatem A; Abd El-Aleam, Rehab H
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成苯并噻唑类化合物作为LasR拮抗剂，通过分子对接和MD模拟研究其与细菌群体感应受体蛋白的结合，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Inhibition of quorum sensing (QS) is an impending approach for targeting bacterial infection. Fourteen benzo[d]thiazole and 2-pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidin-3-yl)benzo[d]thiazoles analogues were designed and synthesized as promising LasR antagonists with QS inhibition activity. Among the investigated compounds, compounds 3c, 3e, and 8d exhibited the highest percentage inhibition in biofilm formation (77 %, 63.9 %, 69.4 %), pyocyanin production (74.6 %, 64.9, 69.4 %), and rhamnolipids production (58.5 %, 51 %, 54.3 %) in P. aeruginosa, respectively. Additionally, compounds 3c, 3e and 8d achieved IC(50) values against Las R equal 1.37 +/- 0.35, 1.55 +/- 0.24, 1.1 +/- 0.15 muM respectively. Also, molecular docking of the target compounds into the LasR binding site co-crystalized "odDHL" revealed their binding with the essential residues for protein inhibition. Additionally, molecular dynamics simulation (MDS) experiments over 200 ns of compound 3c showed its ability to interact with the LasR binding site with dissociation of the protein's dimer confirming its action as a LasR antagonist. The obtained findings inspire further investigation for benzo[d]thiazole and 2-pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidin-3-yl)benzo[d]thiazoles aiming to design and synthesize more potential QS inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 抑制群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）是靶向细菌感染的一种即将采用的方法。设计并合成了14种苯并[d]噻唑和2-吡唑并[1,5-a]嘧啶-3-基）苯并[d]噻唑类似物，作为具有QS抑制活性的有前景的LasR拮抗剂。在所研究的化合物中，化合物3c、3e和8d在铜绿假单胞菌（P. aeruginosa）中分别表现出最高的生物膜形成抑制百分比（77%、63.9%、69.4%）、绿脓菌素产生抑制百分比（74.6%、64.9%、69.4%）和鼠李糖脂产生抑制百分比（58.5%、51%、54.3%）。此外，化合物3c、3e和8d对LasR的IC(50)值分别为1.37 ± 0.35、1.55 ± 0.24、1.1 ± 0.15 μM。同时，将目标化合物分子对接至LasR结合位点共结晶的“odDHL”中，揭示了它们与蛋白质抑制所必需残基的结合。此外，对化合物3c进行的200 ns分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulation, MDS）实验显示，其能够与LasR结合位点相互作用，并导致蛋白质二聚体解离，证实了其作为LasR拮抗剂的作用。所得发现为进一步研究苯并[d]噻唑和2-吡唑并[1,5-a]嘧啶-3-基）苯并[d]噻唑类化合物以设计和合成更多潜在QS抑制剂提供了启发。
